seoTitle: Free Fitness Consultation | CrossFit East Coast, Braintree MA
seoDescription: Coach-led CrossFit and group fitness for adults in Braintree, MA. Book a free consultation, talk through your goals and leave with a plan.
headline: Coached Fitness in Braintree. Book Your *Free* Consultation.
subhead: Sit down with a coach, see if we're the right fit, and leave with a plan built for your goals. Yours to keep, whether you join or not.

thankYou.headline: Your *Free Consultation* Is Claimed
thankYou.subhead: Keep an eye on your phone. A coach from {gym} will text you shortly to set up your consultation.

steps.title: Watch for our text
steps.text: A coach will text you to find a time that fits your schedule.

steps.title: Pick your time
steps.text: Reply with the day and time that work best. That locks in your consultation.

steps.title: Bring your goals
steps.text: Come ready to talk about where you are now and where you want to be. You'll leave with a plan either way.

heroNote: Adult classes for every level, ages 18+.

items.title: Coached Group Classes
items.text: Every workout is coached and scaled to your level, so first-timers and regulars train side by side.

items.title: CrossFit for Beginners
items.text: Learn the basics step by step with a coach beside you. No experience needed.

items.title: Nutrition and Accountability
items.text: Guidance that fits real life, from a team that checks in on you.

items.name: Yolanda
items.text: I'm new to this gym stuff and so far I like it! Everyone has been welcoming and friendly, and the atmosphere is motivating without feeling intimidating.

items.name: Katherine
items.text: I love the atmosphere at CrossFit EC! The coaches are uplifting. Highly recommend it for beginners and experienced CrossFitters!

items.name: Claudia
items.text: Great experience. Positive environment. Focused. Love how they hold you accountable.
